title: Reflections from Abuja to New York: Strengthening the CIVICUS Alliance for Meaningful Action
content:
A message from CIVICUS Secretary General, Mandeep S. Tiwana 

As we navigate a period of profound tumult, moments of collective reflection and strategic alignment are especially important. Our recent Board meeting, held in Abuja, Nigeria from 23 – 25 June, offered an opportunity to reflect on the state of our alliance and the work required to strengthen our collective impact in the years ahead.  

Although civic space restrictions remain acute in many parts of the world, people’s resistance movements are continuing to demonstrate immense resilience, imagination and courage. Against this backdrop, the Board’s discussions were both practical and forward-looking. Key decisions included the approval of our 2026–2027 budget, in-principle agreement to hold the next International Civil Society Week in Latin America  in October 2027, and greenlighting  engagement on the next set of strategic priorities for the CIVICUS alliance to run from 2027–2032. The Board also encouraged us to create better connections between Gen Z-led protests, digital technology and people’s movements, recognising that new forms of organising are shaping civic action in profound ways.
